recipe.prompt:
Use case: player character animation sheet for a side-view pixel-art platformer.
Subject: the same young archer in every frame — small slim figure, green hood pulled up, cream scarf with flowing tails, brown leather tunic with belt, dark green trousers, brown boots, wooden recurve bow held in the left hand, small quiver on the back. Full body, side view facing right.
Rows:
idle = relaxed standing breathing loop, chest rises and falls, scarf tails sway gently, bow held low.
run = smooth 6-frame running cycle, legs fully alternating, arms pumping, scarf trailing behind; last frame flows back into the first.
jump = take-off sequence: slight crouch, push off, rising with knees tucked, arms up, scarf streaming down, reaching the apex pose.
fall = falling loop: legs dangling apart, free arm raised for balance, scarf and hood flapping upward.
Style: crisp detailed pixel art, visible square pixels, consistent 48px-tall character pixel scale, 1px dark outlines, moss green, bark brown and cream palette matching the reference.
Composition: character centered, same size and foot baseline in every frame, feet near the bottom of each cell.
Avoid: changing outfit between frames, extra characters, background scenery, ground shadows, text.

Use case: enemy animation sheet for a side-view pixel-art platformer in a giant mossy tree.
Rows:
thorn_guard = idle loop of a rooted plant sentry: round green spiky bulb with red thorns around its body and one large red eye, sitting in a nest of leaves and roots; it sways and the eye blinks once; side view facing right.
thorn_guard_attack = the same plant shooting: inflates, eye glows bright red as a warning, mouth-pore on its right side opens, spits a thorn to the right, recoils, settles.
shield_beetle = walking loop of an armored dark-teal beetle with a large rounded bark-and-stone shield plate covering its front (right side), six little legs alternating, small glowing eye peeking behind the shield; facing right.
Style: crisp detailed pixel art, visible square pixels, 1px dark outlines, moss green, bark brown, deep teal, red accents, same pixel scale as a 48px-tall human hero; thorn guard about 1.2x hero width, beetle about 1.5x hero width and half as tall.
Composition: subject centered, same size and ground baseline in every frame of a row.
Avoid: background, ground shadows, projectiles flying far from the body, text.

Use case: enemy animation sheet for a side-view pixel-art platformer in a giant mossy tree.
Rows:
cannon_frog = idle loop of a fat squat swamp frog, mossy olive skin with orange belly and warts, a hollow stone barrel growing from its wide mouth pointing up-right like a mortar; throat puffs in and out, eyes blink; side view facing right.
cannon_frog_attack = the same frog lobbing a mud ball: crouches, throat swells huge and glows orange as a warning, launches a brown mud ball out of the barrel up-right, body recoils down, then recovers.
Style: crisp detailed pixel art, visible square pixels, 1px dark outlines, olive, moss, orange and brown palette, same pixel scale as a 48px-tall human hero; frog about 1.4x hero width and 0.8x hero height.
Composition: frog centered, same size and ground baseline in every frame.
Avoid: background, ground shadows, text.

Use case: mini-boss animation sheet for a side-view pixel-art platformer.
Subject: the Tower Stag — a huge ancient forest stag, body of dark bark-brown fur with moss patches, long legs, enormous antlers shaped like gnarled tree branches carrying three glowing teal seed-pod nodes, a pale glowing rune mark on its forehead, small leaves hanging from the antlers. Full body side view facing left.
Rows:
tower_stag = idle loop, breathing, head slowly bobbing, antler nodes pulsing.
tower_stag_shoot = rears head back, antler nodes flare bright, flings glowing seeds from the antlers forward, settles.
tower_stag_stomp = rises on hind legs, front hooves slam down, dust burst at hooves, recovers.
tower_stag_stunned = head lowered to the ground, antler nodes dark, dizzy, forehead rune glowing bright gold as an exposed weak point, slight swaying loop.
Style: crisp detailed pixel art, visible square pixels, 1px dark outlines, bark browns, moss greens, teal glow and gold accents, same pixel scale as a 48px-tall hero; the stag is roughly 4x the hero's height.
Composition: stag centered, same size and hoof baseline in every frame, antlers fully inside the cell.
Avoid: background, ground, shadows, text.

Use case: gameplay effect sheet for a side-view pixel-art platformer.
Rows:
footing_sprout = a small wooden step platform growing out sideways from a wall: starts as a glowing teal arrow tip sparkle at the RIGHT edge of the cell, wood grows leftward into a short thick mossy bark ledge with a few leaves and a teal glowing seam, the final frame is the complete flat-topped ledge about two-thirds of the cell wide, attached to the right edge of the cell, flat top surface.
arrow_hit = small impact spark: wood splinters and a teal-white star flash that bursts and fades.
dust = soft pixel dust puff from footsteps or landing, small beige-grey clouds spreading sideways and dissolving.
leaf_burst = enemy defeat burst: green and teal leaves and petals exploding outward from the center with a bright pop, then scattering and fading.
Style: crisp pixel art, visible square pixels, 1px dark outlines on solid pieces, moss green, bark brown, teal glow, crisp edges (no soft blurry gradients).
Composition: each effect centered in its cell except footing_sprout which is anchored to the right edge.
Avoid: background, text.

Use case: checkpoint and goal objects for a side-view pixel-art platformer in a giant tree.
Rows:
checkpoint = a small mossy carved stone lantern shrine with a root-wrapped base. Frame 1: unlit, dark and dormant. Frames 2-6: lit with a bright teal spirit flame inside, flame flickering through a looping cycle, carved runes glowing teal.
bell = a large old bronze bell hanging from a wooden beam with ropes and moss, swinging cycle: center, swing left, back, swing right, back, with small teal sound sparkles at the far swings.
Style: crisp detailed pixel art, visible square pixels, 1px dark outlines, stone grey, moss, bronze, teal glow, no soft gradients.
Composition: shrine base on the bottom of the cell; bell hanging from the top of the cell; same size in every frame.
Avoid: background, text.

Use case: animated platform and hazard objects for a side-view pixel-art platformer, seen from the side.
Rows:
fold_leaf = a giant flat green leaf platform held horizontal by its stem on the left, wide flat top; frames go from fully open and flat, trembling, drooping, to folded down vertically and closed.
crumble_platform = a mossy carved stone ruin slab, wide and flat-topped; frames go from intact, cracks appearing, splitting, chunks breaking and falling, to only a few falling debris pieces.
launch_flower = a big pink-and-teal bulb flower on a short thick stem: closed bud, squashes down, glows, bursts wide open springing upward, petals fully open, back to half open.
wind_gust = an upward wind column made of crisp white and pale teal curling wind streaks and small leaves rising, looping, tall shape filling the cell vertically.
Style: crisp detailed pixel art, visible square pixels, 1px dark outlines, moss green, bark brown, stone grey, teal glow, no soft blurry gradients.
Composition: platforms centered horizontally with their top surface at the same height in every frame; flower base on the bottom of the cell.
Avoid: background, ground, text.

Use case: thin one-way branch platform for a side-view pixel-art platformer, built from repeating slices.
Subject: a horizontal tree branch slab seen from the side: bright moss and tiny grass tufts on the flat top, bark-brown side face below with grain, rounded broken bark end on the left piece and right piece, center piece repeats seamlessly left to right. Thickness about one third of its height cell.
Style: crisp detailed pixel art, visible square pixels, 1px dark outline, moss green and bark brown matching the reference.
Avoid: background, leaves hanging far down, text.

Use case: climbable hanging vine for a side-view pixel-art platformer; body repeats vertically.
Subject: thick braided green vine with small leaves and tiny glowing teal buds; top_cap = the vine knotted around a small root knob at the top; body = straight vertical braided vine segment that tiles seamlessly top to bottom.
Style: crisp detailed pixel art, visible square pixels, 1px dark outline, moss greens with teal glow accents.
Avoid: background, text.

Use case: decorative building standing on a branch in the starting village of a side-view pixel-art platformer.
Subject: a cozy wooden treehouse hut with mossy shingle roof, round warm-lit windows, small door, a hanging amber lantern, flat bottom edge so it sits on a platform. Side view.
Style: crisp detailed pixel art, visible square pixels, 1px dark outlines, bark brown, moss green, amber glow.
Avoid: background, ground, characters, text.

Soft pale heartwood with smooth curving growth rings and faint glowing grain lines, slightly fibrous and fresh, a few tiny leaf sprouts on the top edge, crisp pixel-art rendering with visible square pixels and a thin dark outline, as in the attached reference

Rough old tree bark with deep vertical grain grooves and knots, a thick bright moss cushion with tiny grass tufts along the top edge, darker shaded underside with dangling root hairs, crisp pixel-art rendering with visible square pixels and a thin dark outline, as in the attached reference

Use case: far parallax background behind a vertical-climbing side-view pixel-art platformer.
Subject: hazy misty interior of a colossal forest of giant tree trunks, distant faded treehouse silhouettes with tiny warm lantern windows and rope bridges between distant trunks, hanging vines, soft green-teal fog layers, very low contrast so gameplay reads on top.
Style: detailed pixel art, visible square pixels, muted moss greens, dark teal and soft amber, matching the reference backdrop.
Usage contract: seamless vertical loop; the central area stays calm with no foreground branches or platforms; flat side-view; no characters.
Avoid: foreground platforms, characters, UI, text, strong bright spots.

Use case: player character animation sheet for a side-view pixel-art platformer.
Subject: the same young archer in every frame — small slim figure, green hood pulled up, cream scarf with flowing tails, brown leather tunic with belt, dark green trousers, brown boots, wooden recurve bow, small quiver on the back. Full body, side view facing right.
Rows:
dash = quick forward dash: low crouch wind-up, explosive lunge forward with body almost horizontal, legs stretched behind, scarf whipping back, short white speed streaks behind, then braking back upright.
climb = climbing up a vertical vine loop, seen from the side: both hands gripping above, hands and knees alternating up, bow slung on the back; last frame flows into the first.
aim = drawing the bow: raise the bow forward, nock an arrow, pull the string back to full draw with the bow held horizontally pointing right, hold full draw trembling slightly, release with the arrow gone and the string snapping forward, follow-through.
hurt = knocked back by a hit: flinch, body jolts backward, hood flies up, stumble, regain balance.
Style: crisp detailed pixel art, visible square pixels, consistent 48px-tall character pixel scale, 1px dark outlines, moss green, bark brown and cream palette matching the reference.
Composition: character centered, same size and foot baseline in every frame (climb frames centered vertically).
Avoid: changing outfit between frames, extra characters, vine or scenery, ground shadows, text.

Use case: player character animation sheet for a side-view pixel-art platformer.
Subject: the same young archer in every frame — small slim figure, green hood pulled up, cream scarf with flowing tails, brown leather tunic with belt, dark green trousers, brown boots, wooden recurve bow, small quiver on the back. Full body, side view facing right.
Rows:
ledge_climb = hanging from an invisible ledge edge to the right with both hands up and body dangling, swinging legs, pulling up with elbows, knee up onto the ledge, rising, standing up on top; the body moves upward through the cell from bottom to top.
wall_slide = pressed with hands and one foot against an invisible wall on the right side, sliding down, scarf and hood fluttering upward, small wood dust specks at the hand; looping.
land = landing from a fall: impact squat with knees bent deep, arms out, small dust specks, rising back to standing idle.
defeat = defeated: staggers, drops to knees, falls forward, lies on the ground, scarf settles, then a soft teal glow wraps the body.
Style: crisp detailed pixel art, visible square pixels, consistent 48px-tall character pixel scale, 1px dark outlines, moss green, bark brown and cream palette matching the reference.
Composition: character centered, same size in every frame, consistent foot baseline for wall_slide, land and defeat.
Avoid: changing outfit between frames, extra characters, walls or scenery, ground shadows, text.
